patent.title: 一种舒缓修护三重蛋白组合物及其应用
assignees: 绽妍生物科技有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E3-N1; embodiments use trade names Bio-Tripro/NovTripro; assignee later renamed 绽妍生物科技股份有限公司 (CP03).

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout E3-N1; cold-start from brand Novtripro narrative.

technology.problem: 舒缓修护化妆品中胶原选择不当、用量大、多蛋白溶解竞争与稳定性问题。
technology.mechanism: 重组Ⅲ型胶原+纤连蛋白+类贻贝粘蛋白按质量百分数与比例复配，并规定化妆品添加量区间（授权权利要求）。
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior soothing cosmetics / single-protein actives in patent background; not independently re-benchmarked.

value_carriers.name: 绽妍JUYOU三重蛋白精润修护舒缓面膜（Novtripro®；候选）
value_carriers.description: Same corporate brand as assignee. Product names Novtripro® triad but does not publish claim-1 wt%/ratio/add-level; no ZL sticker on page. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: Public sources do not establish that the SKU practices granted claim 1 quantitative composition/ratio/add-level.
needed_evidence: Full formula or regulated disclosure matching claim 1 wt% and ratio
Explicit ZL marking tied to verified composition

notes: Holdout E3-N1. T0=2026-10-13. Claims check FAIL → R0; no auto-R3 from Novtripro brand narrative. Formal V0.7/schema 1.0; not V0.8.
